summary: Make admin.ekodi.kr the canonical operator surface for EKODI common services while dedicated runtime hosts remain execution/API boundaries rather than separate administrator products.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly instructed this common-service centralization to be built through completion and then instructed the work to continue after the implementation, validation and production path were reported.
adds: one canonical Common Services operator surface inside Admin
central Admin session authority for common-service operations
Person + Workspace + Role + Capability authorization at runtime boundaries
runtime-root handoff to Admin instead of per-service operator pages
minimal unauthenticated runtime health with protected operational detail
preserves: dedicated runtime and API deployment boundaries
least privilege and explicit capability enforcement
human gates for sovereign high-impact actions
provider independence and workspace data isolation
rollback: Revert PR 1019 and this policy addition. Existing service data, workspace identity, databases, DNS, provider connections and user-service access remain unchanged.
